This name carries the weight of a rich history, as well as the resilience, resourcefulness, and self-sufficiency that these communities have long embodied.

The desert environment is believed to be a testing ground for faith and determination, and these qualities are deeply engrained within the Bedouin way of life. Thus, the name can serve as a reminder of the importance of staying grounded, maintaining a deep connection to one's faith and the natural world, and persevering in the face of adversity.
